goal: Wire all 6 Phase 48 standalone modules into the production pipeline using lazy-init + fallback pattern. No new logic — pure integration wiring.
dependencies: Phase 48: spread_filter, economic_calendar, strategy_fitness, pair_blacklist, trade_attribution, walkforward_optimizer

stories.title: Wire pre-execution gates (SpreadFilter + EconomicCalendar + StrategyFitness) into execute_trade()
acceptance_criteria: Lazy-init SpreadFilter, EconomicCalendarFilter, StrategyFitnessDetector in ExecutionManager.__init__()
SpreadFilter check runs after signal validation, before OANDA init — blocks on REJECT, applies size_multiplier on REDUCE_SIZE
EconomicCalendarFilter check runs after spread check — blocks on BLACKOUT, applies size_multiplier on REDUCE_SIZE
StrategyFitnessDetector check runs after calendar check — blocks on SKIP, applies 0.5x on REDUCE_SIZE
All three use try/except with fallback to allow trade (never crash the hot path)
Each gate logs its action with Phase 49 prefix for observability
Size multipliers from all three gates compound multiplicatively
stories.notes: Pre-execution gate chain wired: SpreadFilter(passed bool) → CalendarFilter(BLACKOUT/REDUCE_SIZE/CLEAR) → FitnessDetector(SKIP/REDUCE_SIZE/NORMAL). Compound multiplier stored in ctx['_phase49_size_multiplier']. Applied before units calculation.

stories.title: Wire PairPerformanceTracker into engine scan loop and post-trade feedback
acceptance_criteria: Lazy-init PairPerformanceTracker in ExecutionManager.__init__()
PairPerformanceTracker.check_pair() called in engine.py _scan_pair() after blocked_pairs check
Blacklisted pairs return PairAnalysis(direction='HOLD', error='pair_blacklisted')
PairPerformanceTracker.update_from_trade() called in sync_closed_trades_rl() for each closed trade
tick_cooldown() called on each scan cycle for cooldown progression
Graceful fallback if tracker unavailable
stories.notes: PairPerformanceTracker wired into both engine.py (_scan_pair blacklist check + scan() tick_cooldown) and execution.py (update_from_trade in sync loop + lazy-init in __init__).

stories.title: Wire TradeAttributionEngine into post-trade feedback loop
acceptance_criteria: Lazy-init TradeAttributionEngine in ExecutionManager.__init__()
attribute_trade() called in sync_closed_trades_rl() for each closed trade with agent verdicts
Weight recommendations logged but NOT auto-applied (human-in-the-loop)
Attribution data appended to journal entry outcome for audit trail
Graceful fallback if engine unavailable
stories.notes: TradeAttributionEngine wired into sync_closed_trades_rl(). Verdicts use (LONG/SHORT, confidence, weight) tuple format. Attribution summary stored in journal outcome. Weight recs logged only.

stories.title: Wire WalkForwardOptimizer into post-trade feedback loop
acceptance_criteria: Lazy-init WalkForwardOptimizer in ExecutionManager.__init__()
record_outcome() called in sync_closed_trades_rl() for each closed trade
run_optimization() called conditionally when should_optimize() returns True
Results written to config_adjustments.json WITHOUT auto-applying
Optimization results logged with Phase 49 prefix
Graceful fallback if optimizer unavailable
stories.notes: WalkForwardOptimizer wired into sync_closed_trades_rl(). TradeOutcome dataclass populated from closed trade data. Conditional run_optimization() with config_adjustments.json output. No auto-apply.
